name: astera-skill-viewer
description: Static three.js replay viewer + headless frame renderer for :tools:game-sim traces (ADR-0225)

scripts.build: bun scripts/embed-sprites.mjs && bun build src/main.js --outfile dist/viewer.js --target browser --minify && cp src/index.html dist/index.html && bun build src/preview.js --outfile dist/preview.js --target browser --minify && cp src/preview.html dist/preview.html && bun build src/preview2.js --outfile dist/preview2.js --target browser --minify && cp src/preview2.html dist/preview2.html && bun build src/viewer3d.js --outfile dist/viewer3d.js --target browser --minify && cp src/viewer3d.html dist/viewer3d.html
